text:
mikaela: Noticing a weird gap in lead assignments since 09:04 — ~15 leads show as "unclaimed" in intake and HubSpot shows enrichment_status=pending. Can we do minimal-impact mitigation so SDRs still get a handoff?

devon: Are these hitting our enrichment timeout or failing with 5xx? I see a small bump in lambda 503s at 09:03.

katie: I can flip a fallback but want to avoid creating SF duplicates. What rules do we have on external_id dedupe?

sam: SF dedupe uses external_id when creating Lead records, but Owner changes will create tasks/notifications. If we assign a placeholder owner and later update owner, we may duplicate tasks. Suggest: assign to a queue owner (Team:Inbound Unowned) and add a temporary note on contact to suppress new-task webhook.

mikaela: Good call. Proposal: quick patch to round-robin to insert a default owner rule "Inbound Unowned Queue" at the top of pipeline, leave enrichment async. Also: set a flag on intake "suppress_task_on_create=true" for this window. Rollback after 30m.

devon: Implementation steps: 1) increase enrichment lambda timeout 10s->25s and retries 2->5 with exponential jitter. 2) insert RR fallback in staging, smoke test. 3) set suppress_task flag via intake config. 4) add note to HubSpot workflow.

katie: Can you post the quick curl and I will run it? I'll also watch SF duplicates for 30m and tag SDR leads.

devon: curl command to patch intake config (staging first):
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://internal-config.redwood/api/v1/lead-routing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"round_robin": {"insert_default_owner_at_start": true, "default_owner": "Inbound Unowned Queue"}, "intake_flags": {"suppress_task_on_create": true}}'
```

sam: FYI grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/leadflow/lead-intake?panelId=7 shows webhook latency spike and enrichment error rate.

mikaela: OK execute plan: devon -> apply lambda bump & retries (dev->staging->prod), devon -> patch RR fallback (staging smoke->prod), katie -> set up SF dup watch & notify #inbound-handoff, sam -> update HubSpot workflow note and set an internal property hs_fallback_assigned=true on affected contacts so we can filter. I will open a JIRA and tag postmortem owners.

katie: I'll be watching duplicates. If dup rate > 2/min or tasks > 5 in 5m, rollback RR change.

devon: Patching enrichment timeout now. ETA ~90s.

jira-bot: Created JIRA-3842: "Inbound enrichment robustness and temporary fallback" assigned to mikaela.

alerts-bot: Lead intake webhook latency alert cleared at 09:10, enrichment 5xx rate trending down.

mikaela: Nice. Once staging smoke passes, devon ping here to roll to prod and leave the suppress_task flag on for 30m. Thanks all. :pray:
